name: meteor swarm
lore:
### The Cataclysmic Descent: *Meteor Swarm*

To command the *Meteor Swarm* is to briefly shoulder the crushing weight of the firmament. As the final syllable of the incantation is uttered, the Weave does not merely bend; it groans under a sudden, localized gravity. The caster feels a searing, white-hot pressure behind the eyes, as if physically dragging jagged stones from the very belt of the heavens.

Visually, the spell is a terrifying spectacle of celestial fury. Four streaks of blinding, orange-white radiance tear through the firmament, trailing plumes of black smoke that choke the air with the scent of ozone and brimstone. Upon impact, the world dissolves into a roar of kinetic thunder and molten fire, capable of turning mountain fortresses to slag.

Legend attributes its discovery to the Archmage Xylos during the Siege of the Glass Spire. It is said he reached into the constellation of the Burning Steed and "plucked the teeth from its maw" to rain them upon the invading legions. Whether Xylos mastered the cosmos or merely survived a desperate accident remains debated, but the glass-rimmed craters he left behind serve as a grim testament to the spell's terrible majesty.
